sources.snippet: Model Description Base Models: Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS): A pre-trained model from Facebook AI Research designed to handle TTS tasks across multiple languages. MMS provides a robust foundation with extensive language support and pre-learned phonetic nuances.

sources.title: TTS Dhivehi Demo - MMS-TTS - a Hugging Face Space by dhivehihacker
sources.snippet: This interface converts Divehi text into natural-sounding speech using a fine-tuned Text-to-Speech model. Leveraging the capabilities of Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS) and VITS models. Text normalization is also incorporated to handle various input formats effectively.
